entries.1acf60cc683bcee2: For the fiscal year ended October 2025, operating loss was ¥623 million (previous year: operating loss of ¥213 million), ordinary loss was ¥651 million, and net loss attributable to owners of the parent was ¥948 million. Segment profit or loss: the Information and Printing Business recorded a loss of ¥158 million (previous year: profit of ¥286 million), the Education Business a loss of ¥118 million, and the Mail-Order Business a loss of ¥19 million; all three were losses. The securities report cites, as background to the loss in the Information and Printing Business, rising raw material costs, electricity charges and logistics costs, and temporary expenses associated with relocating the Tokyo branch office. The net loss includes impairment losses of ¥463 million, factory restructuring-related expenses of ¥146 million and provision for factory restructuring losses of ¥44 million, while a gain on sale of investment securities of ¥360 million is also recorded as extraordinary income. The securities report also states that the major subsidiaries Uiru Kōporēshon and Suzuki Shuppan had net liabilities of ¥3,314 million and ¥633 million, respectively, as of the end of October 2025.

entries.a91be53006acc5e8: Wellco Holdings Corporation is a holding company, and its businesses are shared between 7 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 2 equity-method affiliates. Most of its revenue comes from the Information and Printing Business, which manufactures and sells commercial printed materials such as flyers, direct mail, posters and forms. In addition, it has the Education Business, which publishes books and sells teaching materials, and the Mail-Order Business, which sells beauty foods and health supplements. Of revenue of ¥8,478 million for the fiscal year ended October 2025, the Information and Printing Business accounted for ¥7,753 million, the Education Business ¥684 million and the Mail-Order Business ¥41 million (all of which are revenue from external customers).
